name: Elevatus
summary: Elevatus is a general-purpose hiring platform, not an aviation-specific product. Aviation teams, including Jazeera Airways, have used it for sourcing, screening, video assessments, and onboarding.
paragraphs: Elevatus is a general-purpose hiring platform, not an aviation-specific product. Aviation teams, including Jazeera Airways, have used it for sourcing, screening, video assessments, and onboarding.
whyItMatters: A general hiring platform with a live airline deployment, useful for carriers hiring crew, ground staff and engineers at volume.
